title: calathiana pumila
intro: Calathiana pumila, commonly known as Dwarf Thistle, is a small, herbaceous plant that belongs to the Asteraceae family. The health benefits of Calathiana pumila include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antispasmodic, which can help to soothe digestive issues and alleviate pain. The bioactive constituents of Calathiana pumila include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
